items.title: Google Cloud Warns Three AMD Turin CPU Flaws Could Leak Data Across Processes in VMs
items.description: Google Cloud VMs on AMD Turin chips need a guest OS patch and a stop-and-start to protect against three CPU side-channel flaws, Google said this week. The company has already applied mitigations against attacks between VMs, and between VMs and the host. items.title: Calendar Invites and Live Proxies: Inside a Google Session Hijacking Campaign
items.description: Since mid-August 2026, a phishing operation has been stealing live Google sessions from corporate users. Every check defenders normally lean on to judge a link came back clean, and the operator designed it that way on purpose. The Threat Research team at Material Security spotted the campaign and has since taken down hundreds of attacker domains in an effort the team calls Operation CloudFire.
